title: A medida que: conforme, a la vez que (algo progresa)

sections.content: A medida que (as, in step with) links two things that change together, gradually and in parallel -- as one grows or advances, so does the other. It's especially useful for describing a trend over time. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Esa cifra solo seguía subiendo a medida que la comunidad salvadoreña en el exterior se consolidaba.
items.english: That figure just kept rising as the Salvadoran community abroad grew more established.

items.spanish: A medida que la emigración centroamericana y mexicana crecía, las remesas crecían proporcionalmente.
items.english: As Central American and Mexican emigration grew, remittances grew proportionally.

items.spanish: Las remesas superaban ya los 20.000 millones de dólares anuales, una cifra que, a medida que pasaran los años, seguiría multiplicándose.
items.english: Remittances already exceeded 20 billion dollars a year, a figure that, as the years went by, would keep multiplying.

items.spanish: A medida que el nuevo siglo avanzara, las remesas seguirían creciendo, convirtiéndose en una de las formas más directas en que la globalización conectaba a las familias latinoamericanas con la economía mundial.
items.english: As the new century progressed, remittances would keep growing, becoming one of the most direct ways globalization connected Latin American families to the world economy.

sections.content: A medida que takes the indicative for an ongoing or completed trend (a medida que crecía) and the subjunctive for a trend still ahead in time (a medida que avanzara). Conforme works as a close synonym.
